summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for VaultGold Rewards Android app covering Firebase Auth (Google Sign-In via Credential Manager) & Firestore backend, Unity Ads SDK (Game ID 800370914 in Test Mode), centralized idempotent reward engine, Apps Install Handler, YouTube Watch & Earn discovery/verifiable flows, 10 Puzzle & Brain Game categories with anti-cheat validation, Reusable Task Engine, Google Play Gift-Code Rewards Store, Community Redeem-Code Center, Referrals, Support Tickets, and the 20-module Role-Based Admin Console.
